The '''Office of Budgetary Control''' was an agency of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the reign of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==History==
While [[Obo Rin]] was writing the ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]'' under a commission from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the Office of Budgetary Control was responsible for reimbursing Rin for his expenses. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Herrit]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], who believed Rin's expenses to be inflated and fraudulent, instructed the office to halt the reimbursement. However, Vader's aide [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Solistein]] overruled Herrit.
